name: tkawen-developer-platform
description: TKAWEN developer platform: OpenAPI spec of the TKAWEN OS tenant API and the @tkawen/* npm packages (unpublished).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/verify install && npm --prefix packages/os-sdk install && npm --prefix packages/os-mcp install
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/verify test && npm --prefix packages/os-sdk test && npm --prefix packages/os-mcp test
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/verify run build && npm --prefix packages/os-sdk run build && npm --prefix packages/os-mcp run build
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run ./packages/verify && npm pack --dry-run ./packages/os-sdk && npm pack --dry-run ./packages/os-mcp
